description: Perfume and cologne picks for a moment: a season, an occasion (daytime, office, casual, evening, date night, special occasion), an audience and a style, each with the reason it fits. Use for 'a fresh summer office scent for men', 'date night perfume for her' or 'what fragrance to wear to a winter wedding'. Give at least one of season, occasion, gender or style. Not for taste-based matching (use recommend_perfumes), not for gifts (use find_gift) and not for classics (use search_perfumes with iconic true).

gender.description: Audience the perfume is marketed to. men and women also include unisex perfumes.

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

season.description: Season the perfume suits (fall is accepted in text queries as autumn).

style.description: Styles wanted, e.g. ["fresh","clean"] for summer office wear

items.description: A style word the scent should have.

name: pick_for_occasion
title: Pick perfumes for an occasion
